next.reason: Non-critical return is kept: 1985 'returns control to the next executable statement following the input-output statement'; §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7 b) 'control is returned to an implicit CONTINUE statement following the input-output statement'. The critical case changes: 1985 'If the I-O status value does indicate a critical error, the implementor determines what action is taken' (unconstrained, §1985:VII.1.3.5). §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7 c) 'the implementor determines what action is taken as described in 9.1.13', and §2023:9.1.13.1 constrains it: 'The implementor may either continue or terminate the execution of the run unit. If the implementor chooses to continue ..., control is transferred to the end of the statement ... Any NOT AT END or NOT INVALID KEY phrase specified for that statement is ignored'; §2023:14.6.13.1.3 GR3 then applies the fatal-exception rules. Implementor latitude narrowed (fatal class adds 7x, line-sequential only).
